user.title: Palo Alto Networks firewall
user.description: Use the management IP or hostname of each firewall (not a dataplane/floating address). For an active/passive pair enter both; leave the second blank for a standalone firewall. The account needs XML API access with Operational Requests.

data_description.secondary_host: Leave empty for a standalone firewall.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The firewall rejected the stored credentials.

error.same_device: Both addresses point at the same firewall.

abort.already_configured: This firewall or pair is already configured.

data_description.update_check_hours: Each check contacts the Palo Alto update server from both firewalls.

lookup.name: Look up host
lookup.description: Search the active firewall's ARP table and DHCP leases by IP, MAC or hostname. Returns the matching entries.

query.name: Search
query.description: IP address (exact), MAC address (full or partial, any separator), hostname or interface. Leave empty to return everything.

config_entry_id.name: Firewall
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one firewall or pair is configured.
